boards.title: Your First Weekend at Thomas Jefferson University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key East Falls sequence for learning the campus, getting set up, and sampling its academic, social, and recreation spaces.

cards.title: Start by getting your campus bearings
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Stop at the Kanbar information desk to handle your photo ID, then use the meeting areas to make a simple weekend plan with your map open.
cards.short_summary: The campus social hub and a practical first stop for ID setup.
cards.evidence_claim: Kanbar Campus Center houses the information desk and provides meeting areas, dining, a bookstore, Student Life offices, and recreation space.
cards.access_notes: Regular building hours are posted by Jefferson; photo IDs are issued at the information desk during those hours.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Choose a dinner station that suits your needs, note the dining setup, and keep the meal simple while you learn where campus services are.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining hall with weekday brunch, dinner, and weekend brunch service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson describes Ravenhill as offering retail weekday brunch and all-you-care-to-eat dining for dinner and weekend brunch.
cards.access_notes: Consult Jefferson Dining Services for current meal periods and payment options.

cards.title: Take a quiet Ravenhill pause
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Ravenhill Campus
cards.notes: Walk over to the chapel exterior and nearby breezeway for a calm reset; respect residential areas and follow any posted building-access rules.
cards.short_summary: A named Ravenhill landmark connected to the Mott Hall and Mansion area.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson identifies Ravenhill Chapel as connected with Mott Hall and Ravenhill Mansion through a shared breezeway.
cards.access_notes: Use exterior and common areas only as permitted; Mott Hall is a residence hall.

cards.title: Locate your research home base
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Find the library on the campus map, check its current service information, and identify one place to return for research or course materials.
cards.short_summary: East Falls’ named university library and a useful academic anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s East Falls campus map lists Paul J. Gutman Library as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Thomas Jefferson University East Falls Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service hours before planning a study visit.

cards.title: See where design work takes shape
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning · Lubert Plaza
cards.notes: Walk to the Architecture & Design Center, take in the building from the plaza, and use Jefferson’s tour material to understand its academic role.
cards.short_summary: A former library now used by Jefferson’s architecture and design programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson states that the Architecture & Design Center, built in 1967, was transformed from the university’s first library into the College of Architecture, Design & Engineering’s home.
cards.access_notes: View from public campus areas and follow building-access rules.

cards.title: Add the Art Center to your map
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Make the Art Center one landmark on your campus loop, photograph the exterior if permitted, and check posted information before entering any studio areas.
cards.short_summary: A named East Falls academic building suited to a visual campus-orientation stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s East Falls emergency-preparedness page lists the Art Center among campus buildings.
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access requirements; studio and classroom access may be limited.

cards.entity_name: Gallagher Athletic, Recreation and Convocation Center
cards.title: Find your movement option
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Locate the Gallagher Center and check the current recreation schedule; bring your Jefferson ID if you plan to use facilities that require card access.
cards.short_summary: A campus athletics and recreation center with courts, fitness space, and a jogging track.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson describes the Gallagher Center as containing basketball courts, a fitness center, aerobics studio, racquetball court, and elevated jogging track.
cards.access_notes: Jefferson states that a photo ID provides access to the Gallagher Athletic Center; verify current recreation policies before visiting.

cards.title: Walk past a campus field
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Use Alumni Field as an outdoor waypoint while learning the north side of campus, and keep clear of practices, games, and any marked restricted areas.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic-field destination on Jefferson’s East Falls map.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s East Falls campus map identifies Alumni Field as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Thomas Jefferson University East Falls Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Field availability depends on scheduled athletics and campus operations.

cards.title: Spot a historic Ravenhill landmark
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Ravenhill Campus
cards.notes: Include the mansion exterior on your walking loop, then follow the paths back toward residence areas without entering spaces reserved for residents or events.
cards.short_summary: A named Ravenhill landmark beside the chapel and Mott Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson identifies Ravenhill Mansion as part of the Ravenhill Campus area connected to Mott Hall and Ravenhill Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Enjoy from public exterior areas unless an authorized campus event provides access.

cards.entity_name: Center for Sustainability, Energy Efficiency and Design (SEED Center)
cards.title: Finish with a campus-map check-in
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · East Falls Campus
cards.notes: Use the SEED Center as your final map landmark, then review the route you walked and save the interactive campus map for your first week.
cards.short_summary: A named East Falls destination focused on sustainability, energy efficiency, and design.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson’s East Falls campus map lists the Center for Sustainability, Energy Efficiency and Design (SEED Center).
cards.source_title: Thomas Jefferson University East Falls Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Follow posted building-access requirements; use the official interactive map for current navigation.
